description: This file is a comprehensive Perl script used for running and managing curl test suites remotely or locally. It includes functions for environment setup, test case management, logging, comparing test outputs, interacting with CI systems like Azure and Appveyor, and orchestrating test execution states. It is the main driver script for executing curl's regression tests and verifying their results.

methods.name: logmsg
methods.description: Logs messages to stdout or buffers them if buffering is enabled.

methods.name: singletest
methods.description: Performs a state machine orchestrating the execution and verification of a single test case.

methods.name: singletest_check
methods.description: Verifies the output results of the test against expected data.

methods.name: checksystemfeatures
methods.description: Checks and reports curl and system features such as versions, protocols, and SSL capabilities.

methods.name: displayserverfeatures
methods.description: Displays features supported by the test servers.

methods.name: timestampskippedevents
methods.description: Records timestamps for skipped test events for timing analysis.

methods.name: citest_starttest
methods.description: Registers individual test case execution in the CI system.

methods.name: citest_finishtest
methods.description: Reports the outcome of a single test case to the CI system.

methods.name: updatetesttimings
methods.description: Stores timing data for individual tests.

methods.name: getrunnerlogdir
methods.description: Retrieves the log directory path for a given test runner.

methods.name: getrunnernumlogdir
methods.description: Retrieves the log directory path based on runner number.

methods.name: singletest_shouldrun
methods.description: Determines if a test should be executed based on environment, keywords, and configuration.

methods.name: singletest_count
methods.description: Logs and counts skipped tests; reports test start.
